title: Guard DXR dispatch; clear HDR UAV each frame as visual fallback
motivation: Frames are black because no GPU writes reach the HDR texture: DXR PSO creation fails and the VOL_0001 compute path does not dispatch. Provide a deterministic on-GPU write so Composite can show content while DXR and compute are brought up.
deliverables: Skip the DXR-to-HDR block when PSO/SBT/TLAS are invalid
ClearUnorderedAccessViewFloat on m_hdrTexture each frame with time-varying color
Ensure descriptor heap is set before ClearUAV
Composite pass shows gradient; PIX shows ClearUAV and a fullscreen draw
acceptance: App shows animated color without PIX, no crash
PIX capture contains ClearUnorderedAccessViewFloat on HDR and a Composite draw
No InfoQueue errors during the fallback path
implementation: In renderFrameDXR(): compute a simple RGB color from a running time value
Obtain HDR UAV GPU/CPU handles from descriptor allocator and call ClearUnorderedAccessViewFloat
Guard SetPipelineState1/DispatchRays behind a validity check: PSO != nullptr and SBT/TLAS present
Perform a proper transition for HDR before Composite (handled in DXR_0024)
test_plan: Run Debug build without PIX: animated gradient visible
Run in PIX: verify ClearUAV on HDR, then barrier and Composite draw
Temporarily disable the clear to confirm black returns, then re-enable
